newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,588.2 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,588.2 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 446.6 million Swiss francs to 3,588.2 million in the reporting period ended November 29.
Statement of December 2 in millions of Swiss francs:

Lombard borrowing rose by 9.0 million francs to 9.0 million in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 398.2 million francs to 2,387.8 million.
The rise in Swiss sight deposits in the period was "nothing exceptional" but showed the SNB was still following a generous policy, a central bank spokesman said.

"This was nothing exceptional for this time period," the spokesman told Reuters, noting sight deposits normally rose in the last reporting period of the month. Asked if levels showed the SNB was still following a generous line, he said, "yes."
